scope: Provisional gap classification from all ten immutable Guides gap lines and README. Full-body/source substantive review is complete only for VAT, overview and formation at the specified source scope. This file is not approval of the other seven Guides.

must_fix_before_this_rewrite_can_be_appr: Source contradiction such as invented BE-1 subtitle mismatch
Predecessor rule/topic lost behind a generic destination, even if raw archive/source is retained
Any ordinary rule asserted as operative whose source, temporal scope or computation remains unconfirmed
The unfinished row-level independent review itself
can_remain_in_a_clearly_bounded_source_c: An expressly excluded specialist procedure or treaty table, without an unsupported conclusion in the body
Authenticated portal acceptance, receipts and client-specific submitted forms: publication of researched reference text does not itself require a live client submission
A named implementation question where the body gives only verified statutory scope, identifies the missing operational step and avoids computing an unsupported answer
Uncertified historic periods when the text explicitly confines the supplied treatment to its verified operative date and preserves the historical topic as unresolved
must_not_be_claimed: Complete ordinary-domain coverage while ordinary base/form/deadline gaps remain
Every ledger row substantively checked merely because all quotes/hashes match

ordinary_completion_blockers: Foreign-credit zero/loss and overlap allocation where needed for ordinary computation
Ordinary asset/capped-car and noncash donation reconciliation left incomplete
Deferral-election/prorata implementation and statutory sum-difference routing
bounded_draft_limits: Specialist free-zone, financial, reorganisation and treaty schedules
Portal naming and obsolete printed classifier discrepancies if current statute controls and ambiguity is explicit

ordinary_completion_blockers: Named home-office/mixed-use/car/bad-debt/charity implementation gaps for individual business
Core return evidence/field ambiguity where it affects an actual liability
Actual assessment-limitation topic must be restored or precisely marked unconfirmed
bounded_draft_limits: Special lottery/online routes and voluntary-pension special deductions
Portal-only validation and unavailable historical year figures when not reused as current law

ordinary_completion_blockers: Confirmed lost deregistration, excess-refund interest and exemption topics
Nonexact mixed-input prorata execution remains incomplete
Foreign-currency conversion and ordinary refund application/proof remain incomplete
bounded_draft_limits: Special capital-contribution, assistance-project, customs/DCFTA and energy-trader procedures if explicitly excluded
Unretrieved VAT12 physical layout and authenticated portal acceptance do not invalidate an accurate published instruction map

ordinary_completion_blockers: Full CNAM corporate/inter-account correction entitlement/deadlines
Farm-specific CAS18-AN category mapping
Service-entrepreneur cumulative-band/partial-year/status-overlap corrections for affected ordinary users
bounded_draft_limits: Client-specific old arrears and pre2026 penalty transitions
Bilateral posting/benefit-entitlement variants when expressly outside supplied calculation
New CNAS192-A method must stay dated; lack of earlier2026 commencement evidence does not establish earlier applicability

ordinary_completion_blockers: Actual current return exceptions/field conflicts that change mandatory amounts or reporting
Statutory leave/sickness/severance and execution-deduction computation absent for a comprehensive payroll claim
Remaining ordinary employee-benefit implementation
bounded_draft_limits: FX-linked loan variants, exceptional occupational lists and treaty/posting populations if expressly outside supplied ordinary method
Live portal validation and client-specific correction receipt

ordinary_completion_blockers: Current record-retention trigger
Larger-sample quartile interpolation when computing the advertised range
IUPT partial-year/minimum/equality/refund-floor ambiguities for affected taxpayers
bounded_draft_limits: Legacy technical country mapping, authenticated receipts and APA payment mechanics when clearly not represented as completed
Specialist treaty/OECD dispute and actual comparables require separate facts and sources

ordinary_completion_blockers: PE/company cessation/current-return field method
Residence/tax-paid/refund implementing evidence and limitation computation
Ordinary foreign-credit currency/allocation/timing method
bounded_draft_limits: Treaty-by-treaty rates, MLI/beneficial ownership and specialised migration/CFC routes explicitly outside scope
INR14 portal/year-prefix and obsolete-code uncertainty if no invented accepted value is provided

ordinary_completion_blockers: Invented BE-1 p.j. subtitle inconsistency must be removed
Discrepancy-clearance operational procedure and complete ordinary constitution remain gaps to full formation coverage
bounded_draft_limits: Bank-specific onboarding, national PEP annex and foreign-conviction expiry are explicitly excluded
Full SA securities/sector licensing and first-year support-programme evidence are outside supplied ordinary SRL method

ordinary_completion_blockers: Cannot complete or cure a connected partial domain by linking to it
bounded_draft_limits: A routing overview can remain bounded to verified headlines, population and reporting interfaces; no comprehensive computation claim

ordinary_completion_blockers: Remaining park entry/verification, membership-fee and historical transition methods
Taxpayer-specific withdrawal/re-entry/correction and corporate deferral comparison implementation
bounded_draft_limits: No need for an authenticated real taxpayer submission to publish correctly sourced conditional comparisons
Other incentive schemes and treaty consequences can remain named out of scope

temporal_rule: The broad full2026 commencement gap is a blocker to an unqualified assertion of whole-year completeness. It is not, by itself, proof that a particular current-source rule is wrong. Verify the effective date for each asserted period, or confine the treatment explicitly to the verified operative date; do not extrapolate to earlier periods.
